import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[12][12];
    static int sizeN, maxTime;
    static boolean[][][][][] visited = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reachable = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] timeToReach = new int[12][12];
    static List<List<Integer>> graph;
    static int[][] capacity = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] flow = new int[210][210];
    static int[] nodeExcess = new int[210];
    static int[] nodeHeight = new int[210];
    static int[][] nodeIndex = new int[11][11];

    static void dfs(int step, int x, int y, int startX, int startY) {
        if (maxTime >= 70) return;
        if (x < 0 || x >= sizeN || y < 0 || y >= sizeN) return;
        if (gridA[x][y] < '0' || gridA[x][y] > '9') return;
        if (step > maxTime + 1) return;
        if (visited[step][x][y][startX][startY]) return;
        if (step > timeToReach[x][y] && timeToReach[x][y] != 0) return;
        if (step == timeToReach[x][y] && timeToReach[x][y] != 0 && (gridB[x][y] > '9' || gridB[x][y] <= '0')) return;
        visited[step][x][y][startX][startY] = true;
        if (step < timeToReach[x][y]) {
            dfs(step + 1, x, y, startX, startY);
            dfs(step + 1, x + 1, y, startX, startY);
            dfs(step + 1, x - 1, y, startX, startY);
            dfs(step + 1, x, y + 1, startX, startY);
            dfs(step + 1, x, y - 1, startX, startY);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        sizeN = scanner.nextInt();
        maxTime = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; ++j) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; ++j) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        Deque<int[]> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int[] row : timeToReach) {
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    timeToReach[i][j] = 0;
                    queue.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = queue.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (timeToReach[x][y] >= maxTime) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < sizeN && ny >= 0 && ny < sizeN &&
                    gridA[nx][ny] >= '0' && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' && timeToReach[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    timeToReach[nx][ny] = timeToReach[x][y] + 1;
                    queue.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; ++j) {
                if (timeToReach[i][j] == -1) timeToReach[i][j] = maxTime;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeN; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dfs(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < sizeN; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < sizeN; ++j1) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < sizeN; ++i2) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < sizeN; ++j2) {
                        for (int step = 0; step <= maxTime; ++step) {
                            if (visited[step][i1][j1][i2][j2]) {
                                reachable[i1][j1][i2][j2] = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        graph = new ArrayList<>();
        graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < sizeN; ++i1) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < sizeN; ++j1) {
                if (gridA[i1][j1] > '0' && gridA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int u = graph.size();
                    graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    nodeExcess[u] = gridA[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < sizeN; ++i2) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < sizeN; ++j2) {
                            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && reachable[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int v;
                                if (nodeIndex[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    nodeIndex[i2][j2] = graph.size();
                                    graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                }
                                v = nodeIndex[i2][j2];
                                graph.get(u).add(v);
                                graph.get(v).add(u);
                                capacity[u][v] = 10000;
                                capacity[v][u] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < sizeN; ++i2) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < sizeN; ++j2) {
                if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && nodeIndex[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int v = nodeIndex[i2][j2];
                    graph.get(v).add(0);
                    capacity[v][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    capacity[0][v] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); ++i) {
            nodeHeight[i] = 0;
        }
        nodeHeight[0] = graph.size();

        while (true) {
            boolean updated = false;
            for (int u = 1; u < graph.size(); ++u) {
                while (nodeExcess[u] > 0) {
                    boolean pushed = false;
                    int minHeight = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                        if (capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                            minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, nodeHeight[v]);
                        }
                        if (capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && nodeHeight[u] == nodeHeight[v] + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v], nodeExcess[u]);
                            flow[u][v] += delta;
                            flow[v][u] -= delta;
                            nodeExcess[u] -= delta;
                            nodeExcess[v] += delta;
                            pushed = true;
                            updated = true;
                            if (nodeExcess[u] == 0) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (nodeHeight[u] != minHeight + 1 && minHeight != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        nodeHeight[u] = minHeight + 1;
                        updated = true;
                    }
                    if (!pushed) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!updated) {
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(nodeExcess[0]);
    }
}
